era: Opened 1926; merged with William Penn HS in 1971 to form Harrisburg High School (black and gray, Cougars).
notes: Own colours from the school's 'Pioneer' yearbooks (listed on e-yearbook.com as 'Harris High School'). William Penn (rival) was the Orange and Black Tigers; successor Harrisburg HS (black and gray, Cougars) not applied. Class colours in the books (maroon/gray 1929, turquoise/silver 1935, blue and gold 1928) are per-class, not school colours.
evidence: John Harris 'Pioneer' yearbook OCR text: football 'under the banner of the Crimson and Silver' (1931), 'a Crimson and Silver man recovered' (1932), 'laughed and played ... under the Crimson and Silver' (1929); 1937-39 books call the team 'the Crimson eleven' and say the team got 'new uniforms of crimson and gray' (1939). Afrolumens confirms 'John Harris Pioneers' vs 'William Penn Tigers'. Text only, no hex.
